tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the connected household's saved recipes. Returns matches with sources and saved version IDs. Use get_recipe for ingredients and directions.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Read a recipe from the connected household, including ingredients, directions, and source. Supply version_id for a specific saved version or omit it for the current recipe. Display display_text as the current ingredient wording; raw_text is original source wording. Keep version_id, version_revision,

tools.name: import_recipe
tools.description: Import a public recipe URL or supplied recipe text when the user asks to save it, preserving its creator and source. Returns a background job; check it with get_import_status. Use create_recipe for a new recipe developed in the conversation.

tools.name: get_import_status
tools.description: Check an import job by ID. Report its status; if it needs more information, direct the user to the import in Brie. Poll this job rather than importing again.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description: Save a complete new recipe only after the user asks to save it. Supply ingredients, servings, times, and ordered directions; keep unknown, qualitative, or ranged quantities null and preserve their wording in raw_text. Never invent source facts or macros. tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: Update an existing recipe as a named version only after the user reviews the changes and asks to save them. tools.name: add_grocery_item
tools.description: Add a grocery item to the connected household's private grocery list in Brie.

tools.name: get_grocery_list
tools.description: Read the connected household's grocery list. shop-now covers Upcoming; all-planned includes future planned meals. Returns paginated results; follow next_offset until null to retrieve the complete list.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "create_recipe" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Description of "update_recipe" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: import_recipe, update_recipe · Private data: add_grocery_item · Public sink: update_recipe.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: import_recipe, update_recipe · Private data: add_grocery_item · Public sink: update_recipe

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
